display_chapter_path: 反洗钱/打击资助恐怖主义合规计划
content.stem: 一个国家金融情报机构(FIU)的主要职责包括:(选择两项.)

options.A: 与执法机构、金融机构及其他利益相关方合作,以发现并阻止非法金融活动.
options.B: 对金融机构进行检查,以确保其遵守反洗钱规定.
options.C: 从事向公共和私营部门提供金融服务,包括银行业务和投资活动
options.D: 促进公共部门与私营部门之间的信息交流.
options.E: 制定有关金融机构运营的立法.

content.stem_en: The main responsibilities of a national Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) include: (Select two.)

options_en.A: Collaborating with law enforcement agencies, financial institutions, and other stakeholders to detect and prevent illicit financial activities.
options_en.B: Conducting examinations of financial institutions to ensure compliance with anti-money laundering regulations.
options_en.C: Engaging in providing financial services, including banking and investment activities, to the public and private sectors.
options_en.D: Facilitating the exchange of information between the public and private sectors.
options_en.E: Enacting legislation regarding the operations of financial institutions.
